item.title: The archive's integrity claim is false
item.description: `published/MANIFEST.tsv` is the archive's own claim about itself: for every file under `published/`, a byte count and a SHA-256. It is the mechanism by which the archive can say "this file has not been altered" without anyone having to trust a human.
